title: Dualizing complexes on a locally Noetherian scheme differ by an invertible object
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme and let K and K' be dualizing complexes on X; the lemma asserts that K' is isomorphic to K otimes^L L for some invertible object L of D(O_X) (statement lines 546-552). The proof constructs L = RSheafHom_{O_X}(K, K'), shows that L is invertible because affine locally this is true by Dualizing Complexes, Lemma labelled dualizing-lemma-dualizing-unique and its proof, and shows that the evaluation map L otimes^L K -> K' is an isomorphism for the same reason (proof lines 554-564). Constructing the candidate invertible object and reducing both assertions to the affine case is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
